title: SignedEvalCard
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. A content-addressed, signed eval card (NF-002): the reproducibility key an evaluator's Score references by digest. Carries evaluator identity, judge model + version, prompt version, rubric, dataset version, and a human-agreement calibration summary. eval_card_digest = sha256 over canonical-JSON of this object with the 'signature' block excluded (NF-002 req 5).

card_id.description: Stable evaluator identifier, e.g. 'faithfulness-judge'. Registered as eval-card:<card_id>@<version>+sha256:<hex>.

name.description: Human-friendly evaluator name, e.g. 'Answer Faithfulness Judge'.

version.description: Semantic version of the eval card.

source.description: Evaluator kind / score provenance. Only 'judge' cards MAY spend tokens; 'heuristic'/'code' run zero-token offline (NF-002 req 8). 'human' captures a manual determination.

judge_model.description: Required for source=judge. Pins the judge model identity + configurable private endpoint reference only — never the model bytes (NF-002 req 9).

prompt_version.description: Content hash of the judge prompt template. Required for source=judge.

rubric.description: Scoring rubric text. Required for source=judge.

dataset_version.description: Dataset identity + content pin, e.g. 'golden-faithfulness@3.1.0+sha256:bb22…'. Required for source=judge.

calibration.description: Human-agreement calibration summary. Required for source=judge (NF-002 req 4); 'nova eval card verify' exits non-zero on a judge card missing it.

bias_flags.description: Optional calibrated judge-bias magnitudes (NF-004 hook, NF-002 req 6).

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical-JSON card body excluding this block. Unsigned cards are rejected at registration (NF-002 req 4).

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed (e.g. 'io.langsmith.template').

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

version.description: Judge model version / revision tag when available.

endpoint_ref.description: Reference to a configurable private endpoint (e.g. 'env:NOVA_JUDGE_ENDPOINT'). Never a hardcoded external URL (NF-002 req 9).

human_agreement.description: Agreement coefficient against human labels (e.g. Cohen's kappa).

n.description: Number of human-labeled samples in the calibration set.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Reuses the Evidence-Bundle Ed25519 path (no new crypto dependency).

sig.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical-JSON card body with this block excluded.

x-novafabric.governed_by: NF-002 (evaluator registry + signed eval cards); companion NF-010 unified score schema
x-novafabric.adr: ADR-0099 (evidence-grade evaluation); extends ADR-0080, ADR-0082, ADR-0024
